lines.3: Actually, with Crab moving at a crawl after waking up, it looked like we'd definitely be late after all.
lines.4: 「...Depending on the teacher on duty and how things go, the gate can close three or four minutes earlier or later from one day to the next.」
lines.9: In the end, the usual four of us made a mad dash for school.
lines.12: 「Guh... The school gate's completely shut. Does that mean we have to get late slips?」
lines.13: 「No. I refuse to accept this after we ran all that way. All right, we'll use Formation B and go in from the back.」
lines.14: 「Yeah. Been a while since we did that.」
lines.15: The four of us retraced our steps for a while.
lines.16: A high wall surrounded the entire school grounds.
lines.17: If we scaled the wall at this spot, we could sneak in behind the school building.
